Task: Locate the anchor function for the browser_fp field in the console.log object whose action is fingerprint.collect after selecting scan mode active, hash rounds 2, entropy depth 8, vendor hint chromium, enabling extended signals and canvas probe, then clicking Calibrate, Arm, Preview signals, and Scan and Fingerprint. The anchor function is the first target-specific browser fingerprint value constructor on the dynamic behavior chain: after four-stage UI gating, two-phase custom-event dispatch, signal collection, tuple preparation and asynchronous continuation, its function body itself constructs the target observable fingerprint hash value rather than merely collecting browser signals, dispatching control, packaging a result, or writing to the console. Return exactly one complete function as a single JSON object (see answer_format). Do not return generic utilities, event handlers, the full call chain, raw signal collectors, staged gates, or the final sink.

Example value pattern: ^fp_[a-z0-9]{12}$
Observable: {'type': 'console', 'method': 'log', 'action': 'fingerprint.collect', 'field': 'browser_fp', 'format': '^fp_[a-z0-9]{12}$'}
